definitions.gloss: rear-end collision; an accident in which one vehicle hits the back of another
definitions.explanation: A traffic accident in which the front of one vehicle strikes the rear of the vehicle ahead — typically because the following driver failed to maintain enough distance or did not notice that the vehicle ahead had stopped. One of the most common types of car accident in Japan.

examples.japanese: {追突事故|ついとつじこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
{信号待|しんごうま}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{追突事故|ついとつじこ}にあった。
examples.english: I was rear-ended while waiting at a traffic light.

examples.english: A rear-end collision involving a large truck occurred on the highway, and the long traffic jam is still continuing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ブレーキ→ブレーキ：00022_bureeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}き→利く：11845_kiku⟧にくく⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追突事故|ついとつじこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こして→起こす：01234_okosu⟧しまった⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}している→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: The driver, whose brakes had become less effective in the rain and who ended up rear-ending the car in front, is explaining the situation to the police.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{追突|ついとつ}→追突：17054_tsuitotsu⟧ ('rear-ending; collision from behind') + ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ ('accident'). The first element ⟦{追突|ついとつ}→追突：17054_tsuitotsu⟧ is itself a Sino-Japanese compound from {追|つい}う ('to chase, follow') + {突|とつ} ('to ram, thrust').

USAGE:
- A standard term in news reports, insurance claims, and traffic statistics. Both speakers and writers use it freely.
- Often appears with ⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ ('to cause') for the at-fault driver, and with にあう ('to suffer') or ⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧ ('to be caught up in') for the victim.
- Compare with ⟦{接触事故|せっしょくじこ}→接触事故：24272_sesshokujiko⟧ ('minor side-swipe / contact accident') and {正面衝突|しょうめんしょうとつ} ('head-on collision').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追突事故|ついとつじこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to cause a rear-end collision
- {追突事故|ついとつじこ}にあう: to be rear-ended
- {追突事故|ついとつじこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: a rear-end collision occurs
- {追突事故|ついとつじこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent rear-end collisions
- ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{追突事故|ついとつじこ}: a rear-end collision on the highway
- {玉突|たまつ}き{追突事故|ついとつじこ}: a chain-reaction rear-end collision

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{接触事故|せっしょくじこ}→接触事故：24272_sesshokujiko⟧: minor contact accident — a less severe collision involving glancing contact, often without injury.
- {正面衝突|しょうめんしょうとつ}: head-on collision — the front of one vehicle strikes the front of another; usually more severe.
- ⟦{物損事故|ぶっそんじこ}→物損事故：16540_bussonjiko⟧: property-damage-only accident — categorized by lack of injury, regardless of how the collision occurred.
- ⟦{人身事故|じんしんじこ}→人身事故：08475_jinshinjiko⟧: accident involving injury or death — categorized by human casualties.
- {玉突|たまつ}き⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: chain-reaction accident — multiple vehicles colliding in sequence; often a series of ⟦{追突|ついとつ}→追突：17054_tsuitotsu⟧.
